BiblicalUsage: Samson is born to Manoah and his wife after the angel's promise, slays a thousand men with the jawbone of an ass, and dies with the Philistines when he pulls down the pillars of their temple. His strength is from God, his weakness is Delilah, and his last prayer is answered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Samson is the judge who shows me both halves of a life: the strength God gives and the ruin a man chooses. I hold that his last act is mercy, because the God he called on in the dark still heard him.
